newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak central bank repo avg unchanged 16.50 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak central bank repo avg unchanged 16.50 pct.

text.p: The average rate at a Slovak central bank (NBS) one-week repo tender on Friday was 16.50 percent, unchanged from the average rate at a similar repo on Thursday, the NBS said in a statement.
The NBS offered a maximum 2.0 billion crowns. Overall bids totalled 4.115 billion crowns, and the minimum accepted rate was 15.55 percent, while the maximum rate was 17.00 percent.
The NBS added 1.0 billion crowns to the interbank market through a one-week repo tender on Thursday, the average rate easing to 16.50 percent from 16.74 percent in the previous repo on Tuesday.
According to NBS figures, the Slovak banking sector as of July 23 lacked 1.88 percent of the cumulative funds needed to meet minimum reserves requirements on July 31.
